card.name: The letter r starting split words
card.fires_on: The lone letter "r" that begins a word split into pieces, usually after "a", "the" or "to", before endings like "aven", "abbis" or "aps". Most often a rare or foreign word.

modes.label: After "a"
modes.description: The "r" starts a noun right after the article "a", as in raven or a Japanese term.
modes.example: with a<< r>>aven perched on his forearm

modes.label: Other starts
modes.description: The "r" starts a word after "to", "the" or a comma.
modes.example: Among the<< r>>abbis who officiated in Anish

card.writes: It seems to promote odd letter-string continuations such as RW, rw and Chinese pieces, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires on a stray letter r that begins an uncommon word, such as raven or rabbis, after a small word like a.
